_comment: Each entry -> one or more MP3s in assets/vo/. 'character' fixes the voice. 'rotating': true generates per-guide variants <id>__rumi/__mira/__zoey so each daily guide speaks shared lines in their own voice. 'text' is what gets spoken (can be cleaner than the in-code string; the game matches by id).

lines.text: Hi! I'm Rumi! Welcome to Harmony Harbor! Oh no, the lighthouse went dark and a shy Gloomling is hiding its words. Will you help me read to light it up?
You came back, yay! The dock signs got all mixed up in the wind. Can you read them with me?
Three days in a row, you're a real Star Hunter! The lighthouse keeper left you a note. Let's read it together.
You filled the harbor with harmony! Watch, Rumi is becoming a Rising Star!
Dear friend, the harbor shines because of you. Read on!
Yay! We're friends now! Twinkle, twinkle!
I lost the words. Will you read them with me?
Here we go, read these with me!
Trace along the glowing line, like this!
